text:
Anika Patel: Quick scheduling q — can we move next week's cross-func sync from Wed 11am to Tue or Thu? I have an all-hands clash.
Sam Cho: Tue works for me, Thu also ok. prefer earlier in the day.
Lee Rivera: Thu afternoon is rough for infra folks. Tue 10am or Tue 2pm better.
Maria Gomez: I'm out Tue morning for customer meeting. Tue 2pm or Thu 11am are the only good slots for product.
Anika Patel: OK trying to find overlap — putting up a 3-option poll: Tue 10a / Tue 2p / Thu 11a. Can folks vote by EOD? link: https://doodle.com/poll/redwood-xfunc-sync (placeholder)
Sam Cho: voted.
Lee Rivera: voted.
Maria Gomez: voted.
Anika Patel: Agenda draft so we can assign owners before the sync: ```1) Roadmap slotting — tradeoffs between Dedicated vs Hosted prioritization (10m)
2) RFC-2026: model routing policy (15m)
3) Triage: high-latency customer reports + short remediation plan (10m)
4) Decision log update & action items (5m)
5) Quick CR check: outstanding review queue and owner pings (5m)```
Anika Patel: Proposed owners: roadmap -> @Maria, RFC-2026 -> @Lee, triage -> @Sam, decision log -> @Anika, CR check -> ops rotation. Anyone want to swap?
Sam Cho: I can take triage. I'll pull the latency summary beforehand.
Lee Rivera: I'll own RFC-2026 review. I'll post a short comment thread on the RFC with the blockers I see.
Maria Gomez: Happy to handle roadmap context and make the tradeoff slides. Can someone add the latest Dedicated perf numbers to the doc?
Sam Cho: @Maria I can add the perf table by EOD. Also pinging @eng-team for any pre-reads.
Anika Patel: Great — action items: Sam -> latency summary + perf table, Lee -> RFC comment + short list of compatible fallbacks, Maria -> roadmap slides. I'll update the decision log template and add a section for rollout criteria.
Maria Gomez: For CR check — can we surface the two PRs blocking release? PR#457 and PR#462. @Sam can you nudge reviewers?
Sam Cho: On it, will ping reviewers in #eng-review and add a short note in PRs.
Lee Rivera: Small note: RFC-2026 has a kernel-selection appendix. If we don't have time in the sync, we can async-review that appendix and drop key decisions into the decision log.
Anika Patel: Sounds good. If poll finishes with Tue 2pm we keep it as a focused 45m meeting (tight): main goal is roadmap + RFC decision. If Thu 11am majority then we'll make it 60m.
Maria Gomez: Agree — prefer shorter if Tue 2p.
calendar-bot: Poll closed — majority selected Tue 14:00. Event created: Cross-functional sync — Tue 14:00–14:45. Agenda and owners added to event description. :white_check_mark:
Anika Patel: Thanks all — I'll send the calendar invite and drop the event doc link in the thread. Please add any final pre-reads. :thumbsup:
